name: file-input
title: File input
description: The fleet file field: a paperclip button and the chosen file's name, instead of the browser's own control.

files.content: import { type ChangeEventHandler, type InputHTMLAttributes } from "react" type FileInputProps = Omit< InputHTMLAttributes, "className" | "onChange" | "type" | "value" > & { /** The chosen file's name — the caller owns the file, the field only shows it. */ fileName?: string | null /** What stands in for the name before anything is chosen. */ placeholder?: string className?: string onChange: ChangeEventHandler } /** * The fleet file field: a paperclip button and the chosen file's name. * * A bare `` is drawn by the browser — the button lands wherever the * browser puts it (in a narrow grid cell it used to sink to the bottom of the field), * and it is the one control whose look we cannot reach. Here the input is hidden and a * label stands in for it, so the control is the fleet's own button. */ export function FileInput({ fileName, placeholder = "Файл не выбран", className, onChange, ...rest }: FileInputProps) { return ( ) }
